name: Administrative Dismantling and Enserfment of the Left Bank (1781–1786) (C0034)

techniques.comment: The abolition of the Cossack regimental order and the division of the Left Bank into imperial viceroyalties: the Kyiv Viceroyalty was established by the nominal decree to the Senate of September 16, 1781 (PSZRI, coll. 1, vol. XXI, no. 15,228; execution ordered from November)(Citation: Именный указ, данный Сенату, об учреждении Киевского наместничества 1781)(Citation: Полное собрание законов Российской империи. Собрание первое. Том XXI (1781-1783) 1830), "which finally abolished the remnants of the Hetmanate's autonomy and its regimental-sotnia administrative-political and military order"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 4 2007); the same decree established the Chernihiv and Novhorod-Siverskyi viceroyalties.

The secularization and confiscation into the imperial treasury of the lands of Ukrainian Orthodox monasteries: "in 1786, during the secularization, the monastery was closed, and its property and lands passed to the state treasury"(Citation: Енциклопедія історії України: Т. 9 2012) – the fate of the Sviatohirsk monastery is typical of the entire 1786 campaign, which deprived the local church of its economic base.

The legal enserfment of Ukrainian peasants by Catherine II's decree of May 3, 1783, depriving them of the right of free movement: "For the certain and reliable collection of treasury revenues in the viceroyalties of Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Novhorod-Siverskyi and for the prevention of any flights… each of the villagers is to remain in the place and station where he is registered by the current last revision"(Citation: Указ Екатерины II о податях 1783).
